extensions.name: CDWAgent
extensions.description: Multimodal access to the UCSF Clinical Data Warehouse through natural language. One-call cohort building across diagnoses, medications, procedures, labs, radiology/imaging, immunizations, allergies, and vitals; clinical-notes/NLP search; read-only queries, schema discovery, and structured results. 28 tools, including durable query jobs for long exports. Requires UCSF network credentials (CAMPUS\username and password).

extensions.name: UCSFOMOPAgent
extensions.description: Natural language SQL on the UCSF OMOP de-identified clinical database. Read-only access to standardized EHR data under the OMOP Common Data Model. 11 tools: built-in OMOP/SQL-Server context, concept search, a lab finder, live schema tools, and durable query jobs for long exports. Requires UCSF credentials.

extensions.name: Playwright Agent
extensions.description: Browser automation via Microsoft's @playwright/mcp 0.0.86, pinned to a reviewed set of 24 tools. Navigate websites, extract data, fill forms, and run web research workflows using structured accessibility snapshots. No vision model required. Requires Node.js on the host.

extensions.name: SPOKEAgent
extensions.description: Structure-aware access to the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph (43M nodes): live schema introspection, entity/identifier resolution with label validation, node profiling, shortest-path finding, and guarded read-only Cypher across diseases, genes, proteins, drugs, and pathways, with query jobs for long queries. 8 tools and a bundled spoke-knowledge-graph skill. Access requires a passcode from UCSF (see credentials page).

extensions.name: CodeGraph Agent
extensions.description: Code knowledge graph for a project's source: explore, symbol lookup, search and callers from a pre-built index. Runs upstream CodeGraph 1.6.4 (MIT) on about 30 languages, including Python, R, TypeScript, C and C++, Rust, Go and Java. Indexes only the project you name, never your home folder.

extensions.name: BiorOffice
extensions.description: Create, read, and edit Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) files from chat. Handles headings, tables, charts, and 150+ Excel functions with live formula evaluation. Built on the open-source OfficeCLI engine, so no Microsoft Office install is needed. Ships four bundled skills for the office suite, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

extensions.name: gptr Agent
extensions.description: Work inside an R session you already have open. Biorouter inspects, analyses, plots and fixes objects in memory through gptr, without reloading data, and every call passes gptr's permission settings. Private: a public model never sees your session. 3 tools and a bundled gptr-live-r skill. Needs R with the gptr package (1.0 or later) and uv.

extensions.name: Open Computer Use Agent
extensions.description: A fallback for desktop control where the built-in Biorouter Copilot does not work, for example Linux with at-spi2-core older than 2.52 (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, Rocky 9) or an app whose controls Copilot cannot read. Try Copilot first. Built on Open Computer Use 1.1.5 (MIT); asks once per chat before it acts. macOS 14 or later, Windows x64, and Linux on X11. 12 tools. Needs Biorouter 1.94.6 or later.

extensions.name: IDCAgent
extensions.description: Search NCI Imaging Data Commons through IDC's official hosted MCP server: collections, attributes, clinical tables, cohorts, download URLs, viewer links and SQL over IDC's index. Public data, no key needed. 20 tools.

extensions.name: Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP
extensions.description: Biorouter rebuild of Folklore MCP 2.0.0: eleven public tools for GRCh38 germline variant classification under ACMG/AMP, gene profiles, ClinGen associations and scientific literature. Use public inputs only; do not send patient or private case data. Results require qualified professional review and are not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

extensions.name: BioMCPAgent
extensions.description: Entity-centred biomedical search with BioMCP 0.9.3 (MIT): genes, variants, drugs, diseases and trials across PubMed, Europe PMC, PubTator, ClinVar, MyVariant, MyGene, ClinicalTrials.gov, OncoKB, OpenFDA, Reactome and cBioPortal. Each data source's own terms apply, and some restrict commercial or clinical use. Replaces ClinicalVariantAgent. 7 tools.

extensions.name: ChemoinformaticsAgent
extensions.description: Compute molecular descriptors, fingerprint similarity, substructure matches and standardised structures locally with RDKit, and look up compounds in PubChem and ChEMBL. No key needed. 6 tools.

extensions.name: OpentronsAgent
extensions.description: Simulate Opentrons Flex protocols with the opentrons 10.1.0 package and look up the labware definitions it ships, plus Opentrons shared data on GitHub. A simulation runs the protocol's Python on this computer after a static check, stops after 60 seconds, and Biorouter asks before each run. It never talks to a robot. No key needed. 5 tools.

extensions.name: LaminDBAgent
extensions.description: Search, filter and describe a LaminDB instance's artifacts, collections, runs, features and labels, with their lineage, through the lamindb 2.12.2 library. Read only: nothing is saved, deleted or moved. Your LaminDB key goes only to Lamin. 6 tools.

extensions.name: CellxGeneCensusAgent
extensions.description: Query the CELLxGENE Census of single-cell data with the cellxgene-census library: releases, datasets, cell counts, cell metadata and per-group gene expression summaries with size caps, plus the CELLxGENE Discover curation API. Replaces SingleCellOmicsAgent. No key needed.

extensions.name: PrimeKGAgent
extensions.description: Download the PrimeKG precision medicine knowledge graph once from Harvard Dataverse (about 1 GB, checksums checked) and query it on this computer: node lookup, neighbours and short paths between drugs, diseases, genes and phenotypes. No key needed.

extensions.name: MarkItDownAgent
extensions.description: Convert files the built-in document tools do not read to Markdown with Microsoft's MarkItDown 0.1.9 (MIT): PowerPoint, EPUB, Outlook .msg, older .xls, notebooks, ZIP archives, image and audio metadata, YouTube transcripts, RSS and Wikipedia pages. One tool.

extensions.name: RowanMolecularModelingAgent
extensions.description: Submit Rowan cloud molecular modelling workflows (pKa, conformers, descriptors, solubility, docking and more) for a molecule, poll their status and read their results, through rowan-python 3.3.4. A submission spends Rowan credits, so Biorouter asks before every one. Your Rowan key goes only to api.rowansci.com. 7 tools. Needs Python 3.13 or later.

extensions.name: BenchlingAgent
extensions.description: Read Benchling projects, registry records, notebook entries and assay metadata, and make writes that Biorouter asks you to approve. Your key goes only to your own tenant. Tools: benchling_status, benchling_get, benchling_write.

extensions.name: DNAnexusAgent
extensions.description: Read DNAnexus projects, files, apps, workflows and job metadata, and make writes that Biorouter asks you to approve. Your token goes only to api.dnanexus.com. Tools: dnanexus_status, dnanexus_get, dnanexus_write.

extensions.name: ProtocolsIOAgent
extensions.description: Search and read protocols.io protocols for method discovery, citation and reproducible protocol review. Your access token goes only to www.protocols.io. Tools: protocolsio_status, protocolsio_get.

extensions.name: AdaptyvBioFoundryAgent
extensions.description: Read Adaptyv Foundry targets, sequences, experiments, quotes and results, and make writes that Biorouter asks you to approve. Your token goes only to devs.adaptyvbio.com. Tools: adaptyv_status, adaptyv_get, adaptyv_write.

extensions.name: TamarindBioAgent
extensions.description: Read Tamarind Bio tools, jobs, files and results, and make writes that Biorouter asks you to approve. Your key goes only to app.tamarind.bio. Tools: tamarind_status, tamarind_get, tamarind_write.

extensions.name: ProteinStructureAgent
extensions.description: Read protein structure and sequence resources from RCSB PDB, AlphaFold DB and UniProt. Read only, no key needed. Tools: proteinstructure_status, proteinstructure_get.

extensions.name: LiteratureAgent
extensions.description: Search and read scholarly metadata from OpenAlex, Crossref, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, bioRxiv and medRxiv, and Unpaywall for citation checks and evidence review. Your Semantic Scholar key goes only to Semantic Scholar. Replaces StructuredPaperSearchAgent. Tools: literature_status, literature_get.

extensions.name: Public Bio Databases
extensions.description: Look up genes, sequences, proteins, variants and drug-gene annotations in NCBI E-utilities and BLAST, UniProt, Ensembl and ClinPGx. Read only, no key needed. Replaces NCBIAgent. Tools: publicdb_status, publicdb_get.

extensions.name: ZoteroAgent
extensions.description: Read Zotero libraries, collections, items and tags through the Zotero web API, and add items or collections with approval. Your key goes only to api.zotero.org. Tools: zotero_status, zotero_get, zotero_write.

extensions.name: ScientificWebResearchAgent
extensions.description: Search the web for scientific sources with Exa and Tavily, with typed search tools. Each key goes only to its own service. Tools: webresearch_status, webresearch_get.
